_comment: Manual overrides for scripts/composio_coverage.py. slug is the primary Composio catalog slug, or null to force status=none. siblings are extra slugs for the same product. note is recorded in the coverage CSV.

whatsapp-business.note: Catalog slug is whatsapp; the toolkit description says it is the WhatsApp Business API, not WhatsApp personal.

gohighlevel.note: Composio splits GoHighLevel into a location API (primary), an agency API, and an official MCP toolkit.

mongodb-atlas.note: The mongodb toolkit is the Atlas administration API (organizations, projects, clusters), not a generic self-hosted MongoDB driver.

youtube-transcript.note: Catalog youtube_transcript is youtubetranscript.dev, a different vendor from transcriptapi.com in the research set.

zoho-crm.note: No dedicated Zoho CRM toolkit. Other Zoho product toolkits and the generic zoho app are not Zoho CRM.

amazon-selling-partner.note: Catalog amazon is a generic marketplace entry (0 tools in this snapshot), not the Selling Partner API.

mermaid-cli.note: mermaid_chart_mcp is Mermaid Chart (mermaid.ai), not the mermaid-js mermaid-cli tool listed here.
